note: 204 topic outlines; not 204 playable or pedagogy-validated lessons. Beginner/A1 and Elementary/A2 are project naming conventions.

modules.title: Ilk muloqot va yordam so‘rash
modules.prerequisites: Yo‘q. Ko‘rsatmalar o‘zbekcha va namuna bilan.
modules.objective: Oddiy muloqotni boshlash va tushunmaganda yordam so‘rash.

modules.title: Tovush va alifbo poydevori
modules.prerequisites: Z-M01; og‘zaki yo‘l bilan parallel davom etadi.
modules.objective: Harf nomi bilan tovushni farqlash va ilk tovush-harf mosligini o‘rnatish.

topics.title: Inglizcha tovushlarni eshitib ajratish
topics.example: Bir xil yoki turli tovushni aniqlash.

topics.title: Ilk harf-tovushlar: s/a/t/p/i/n guruhi
topics.example: s, a, t, p, i, n tovushlari.

topics.title: Keyingi undoshlar va qisqa unlilar
topics.example: m, d, g, o, c/k, e, u kabi bosqichli to‘plam.

modules.title: So‘zni o‘qish va yozishga kirish
modules.objective: O‘rgatilgan tovushlardan sodda so‘zni o‘qish va yig‘ish.

topics.title: Bosh harf va nuqta bilan ilk tanishuv

modules.title: Rang, shakl va qarama-qarshiliklar
modules.prerequisites: Z-M01; so‘zlar dastlab audio va rasm bilan.
modules.objective: Buyumni ko‘rinishiga ko‘ra farqlash va nomlash.

topics.title: Qo‘shimcha ranglar
topics.example: black, white, orange, pink, brown, purple, grey.

topics.title: Bir belgili buyum tavsifi
topics.example: a red ball, a small box.

modules.title: Son va sodda miqdor
modules.objective: 20 gacha miqdorni tushunish va yoshni aytishga tayyorlanish.

topics.title: Sonlar 0–5
topics.example: zero, one, two, three, four, five.

modules.title: Men va tanish odamlar
modules.objective: Ism, yosh va yaqin odamlar haqida tayyor sodda iboralarni ishlatish.

topics.title: Oila a’zolari
topics.example: mum, dad, sister, brother, grandma, grandpa.

modules.title: Bola atrofidagi ilk lug‘at
modules.prerequisites: Z-M04–Z-M06; rasm-audio bilan mustaqil lug‘at yo‘li.
modules.objective: Tanish buyum, hayvon va harakatni eshitib aniqlash.

topics.title: Tana a’zolari
topics.example: head, eyes, ears, nose, mouth, hands.

topics.title: Ilk harakatlar
topics.example: sit, stand, walk, run, jump, clap.

modules.title: Poydevorni birlashtirish
modules.objective: O‘rgangan so‘z va iboralarni yangi rasm, ovoz va suhbatda qo‘llash.

topics.title: Zero yakuniy tekshiruvi
topics.example: Yangi buyumlar bilan tinglash, o‘qish va tanishtirish.

modules.title: Shaxs va to be — tasdiq
modules.prerequisites: Z-M06; Z-M03 o‘qish yo‘li davom etadi.
modules.objective: Kim yoki nima ekanini sodda gap bilan aytish.

topics.title: Am/is/are — tasdiq
topics.example: I am ten. They are friends.

topics.title: Oddiy gap tartibi: ega + fe’l + to‘ldiruvchi
Ism/yosh/yashash joyi profilini aytish
topics.example: I’m Ali. I’m ten. I’m from Tashkent.

modules.title: To be — savol va inkor
modules.objective: Shaxsiy ma’lumotni tekshirish va savolga javob berish.

topics.title: To be bilan qisqa javoblar
topics.example: Yes, I am. No, he isn’t.

topics.title: What/who — to be bilan
topics.example: Who is she? What is it?

modules.title: Ot, artikl va ko‘rsatish
modules.objective: Buyumni nomlash, birlik-ko‘plik va yaqin-uzoqlikni ifodalash.

topics.title: This/that
topics.example: This is a bag. That is a kite.

topics.title: These/those
topics.example: These are pens. Those are books.

modules.title: Egalik va oila tavsifi
modules.objective: Buyum kimniki ekanini va oila a’zolarini tasvirlash.

topics.title: Sifat + ot va sifatning to be dan keyin kelishi
topics.example: a tall boy / The boy is tall.

topics.title: Oila va tashqi ko‘rinish bo‘yicha sodda tavsif
topics.example: My sister is tall. Her hair is black.

modules.title: Uy va buyum joylashuvi
modules.objective: Xona ichidagi narsalar va ularning o‘rnini tushuntirish.

topics.title: There isn’t/aren’t va Is there/Are there
In/on/under
topics.example: The ball is under the bed.

topics.title: Next to/behind/in front of/between
topics.example: The shop is next to the park.

modules.title: Borlik, tana va kiyim
modules.objective: Egalik, tashqi ko‘rinish va buyum mavjudligini aytish.

topics.title: Tana va tashqi ko‘rinish lug‘atini kengaytirish
Kiyim va kiyingan odamni tanish
topics.example: The girl has got a red hat.

modules.title: Qobiliyat, ruxsat va ko‘rsatma
modules.objective: Qila olishni aytish, sodda ruxsat va ko‘rsatmani tushunish.

topics.title: Can/can’t — qobiliyat
topics.example: I can swim. He can’t fly.

topics.title: Please bilan iltimos va javob
topics.example: Pass me the pen, please. Here you are.

modules.title: Kun tartibi — Present Simple
modules.objective: Odat va kundalik ishlarni tushuntirish.

topics.title: Kundalik fe’llar va kun qismlari
topics.example: get up, have breakfast, go to school.

topics.title: Do/does savollari va qisqa javoblar
topics.example: Does she read? Yes, she does.

topics.title: What/where/when — do/does bilan
topics.example: When do you go to school?

modules.title: Vaqt, odat va yoqtirish
modules.objective: Jadval, vaqt va yoqtirish haqida suhbatlashish.

topics.title: Hafta kunlari va at/on/in — vaqt
topics.example: on Monday, at seven, in the morning.

topics.title: Like/love/don’t like + ot yoki -ing
topics.example: I like apples. I like swimming.

modules.title: Hozirgi harakat — Present Continuous
modules.objective: Ayni paytdagi voqeani va odatni farqlash.

topics.title: Present Continuous inkor/savol/qisqa javob
topics.example: Are they playing? No, they aren’t.

topics.title: Hozirgi harakat va odat farqi
topics.example: I walk daily. I’m running now.

topics.title: Kiyimni va joriy harakatni tasvirlash
topics.example: He is wearing a blue shirt.

modules.title: Ovqat va kundalik xizmat
modules.objective: Sodda xarid va buyurtmani bajarish.

topics.title: Some/any — boshlang‘ich bor-yo‘qlik
topics.example: There’s some milk. Is there any bread?

topics.title: Xarid dialogi va sodda e’lonni o‘qish
topics.example: Two apples, please. Here you are.

modules.title: A1 ko‘nikmalarini birlashtirish
modules.objective: Tanish mavzularda qisqa mustaqil muloqot, o‘qish va yozish.

topics.title: And/but/because — sodda bog‘lash
topics.example: I like it because it’s funny.

topics.title: Qisqa xabar va sodda paragraf
topics.example: Do‘stga o‘zi va kun tartibi haqida yozish.

topics.title: Tinglab detal olish va sodda matnni tushunish
A1 yakuniy amaliy tekshiruv
topics.example: Tanishuv + xona + jadval + xarid: yangi vaziyatda.

modules.title: Kengaygan kundalik muloqot
modules.objective: Oldingi bilim bilan uzoqroq kundalik suhbat olib borish.

topics.title: A1 diagnostikasi va bo‘shliqlarni to‘ldirish
topics.example: To be / do / can xatolarini ajratish.

topics.title: Something/anything/nothing/someone…
topics.example: Is there anything in the box?

topics.title: Tushunishni tekshirish va qayta so‘rash
topics.example: Do you mean Tuesday? Could you repeat that?

modules.title: Miqdor va ovqatni chuqurlashtirish
modules.objective: Miqdor, yetarlilik va taom tayyorlashni tushuntirish.

topics.title: Much/many/a lot of
topics.example: How much water? How many eggs?

topics.title: A bottle of/a piece of/a kilo of

modules.title: Taqqoslash va tavsif
modules.objective: Buyum, odam va xizmatlarni sodda mezonlar bo‘yicha taqqoslash.

topics.title: As…as / not as…as
topics.example: This bag is as big as mine.

topics.title: Too + adjective / adjective + enough
topics.example: It’s too heavy. It’s big enough.

topics.title: Adverbs of manner: -ly va asosiy istisnolar
topics.example: She speaks slowly. He runs fast.

modules.title: O‘tgan holat — was/were
modules.objective: O‘tgan joy, holat va mavjudlikni tushuntirish.

topics.title: Yesterday/last…/…ago
topics.example: We were here two days ago.

topics.title: O‘tgan holat bo‘yicha qisqa xabar
topics.example: It was cold. We were indoors.

modules.title: Past Simple — harakatlar
modules.objective: O‘tgan voqeani aytish va suhbatda aniqlashtirish.

topics.title: Did…? va qisqa javoblar
topics.example: Did you see it? Yes, I did.

topics.title: Wh-savollar va voqea ketma-ketligi
topics.example: Where did you go? What happened next?

modules.title: Hikoya va jarayon
modules.objective: Voqea paytidagi harakatni tasvirlash va sodda hikoya tuzish.

topics.title: Past Simple va Past Continuous
topics.example: I was walking when it started to rain.

topics.title: When/while — sodda vaqt bog‘lash
topics.example: While I was reading, she was drawing.

topics.title: Rasmlar asosida sodda hikoya
topics.example: Vaqti, qahramoni va yakuni bor hikoya.

modules.title: Kelajak rejalari va kelishuv
modules.objective: Niyat, kelishilgan reja va sodda bashoratni farqlash.

topics.title: Be going to — niyat va reja
topics.example: I’m going to visit my grandma.

topics.title: Kelajak shakllarini vaziyatda tanlash
topics.example: Niyat, kelishuv va tezkor qarorni ajratish.

modules.title: Qoida, maslahat va taklif
modules.objective: Zarurat, taqiq, maslahat va odobli so‘rovni ifodalash.

topics.title: Have to/don’t have to
topics.example: We have to wear a uniform.

topics.title: Could — o‘tgan qobiliyat va odobli iltimos
topics.example: I could swim at six. Could you help me?

topics.title: Would like to / Would you like…?
topics.example: Would you like to join us?

modules.title: Shart, maqsad va sabab
modules.objective: Sodda shart, sabab va maqsadni tushuntirish.

topics.title: Zero Conditional — sodda doimiy natija
topics.example: If you heat ice, it melts.

topics.title: First Conditional — sodda mumkin kelajak
topics.example: If it rains, we’ll stay inside.

topics.title: When va if — kelajak vaziyati
topics.example: When I arrive, I’ll call you.

topics.title: Because/so va sabab-natija
topics.example: I was tired, so I went home.

topics.title: Infinitive of purpose
topics.example: I went to the shop to buy bread.

topics.title: Want/need/plan/hope + to
topics.example: We plan to visit the museum.

modules.title: Tajriba va hozirgi natija
modules.objective: Sodda tajriba haqida so‘rash va hozirgi natijani aytish.

topics.title: Present Perfect savol va qisqa javob
Ever/never — hayotiy tajriba
topics.example: Have you ever ridden a horse?

topics.title: Present Perfect va Past Simple — kirish
topics.example: I’ve seen it. I saw it yesterday.

modules.title: Joy, yo‘l va sayohat
modules.objective: Manzil topish, jadvalni tushunish va sayohat xizmatidan foydalanish.

topics.title: Harakat predloglari
topics.example: to, from, into, out of, across, through.

topics.title: Yo‘l so‘rash va ko‘rsatish
topics.example: Go straight. Turn left at the bank.

topics.title: Transport/chipta/jadval va sayohat sanalari
topics.example: The train leaves at quarter past ten.

topics.title: Mehmonxona/yo‘qolgan buyum va yordam
topics.example: I’ve lost my bag. Can you help?

modules.title: Bog‘langan gap va tabiiy ifoda
modules.objective: Odam, buyum va ishni sodda bog‘langan gap bilan aniqlash.

topics.title: Who/which/that — defining relative kirish
topics.example: The girl who lives next door.

topics.title: Like/enjoy + -ing va would like + to
topics.example: I enjoy reading. I’d like to read it.

topics.title: Fe’l-predlog birikmalari
topics.example: listen to, wait for, look at.

topics.title: Kundalik phrasal verbs
topics.example: get up, turn on, put on, look for.

topics.title: So/but/although va sodda qarama-qarshilik
topics.example: Although it was cold, we went outside.

modules.title: Keng lug‘at va ijtimoiy vaziyatlar
modules.prerequisites: E-M01–E-M12 dagi mos tuzilmalar; domenlar oldin ham beriladi.
modules.objective: O‘rgangan shakllarni turli kundalik sohalarda qo‘llash.

topics.title: Sog‘liq, tana va yordam so‘rash
topics.example: I’ve got a headache. I need help.

topics.title: Sport, bo‘sh vaqt va taklifga javob
topics.example: I’d love to, but I can’t.

topics.title: Kasblar, maktab ishlari va kelajak istagi
topics.example: I’d like to be a vet.

topics.title: Texnologiya va sodda yo‘riqnoma
topics.example: Save the file, then close the window.

topics.title: Tabiat/hayvonlar/atrof-muhit
topics.example: We should keep the park clean.

topics.title: Hislar, fikr va muloyim kelishmovchilik
topics.example: I think it’s good, but I prefer this one.

modules.title: A2 ko‘nikmalari va yakuniy bog‘lash
modules.objective: Kundalik yangi vaziyatda bog‘langan og‘zaki va yozma javob berish.

topics.title: Qisqa email: taklif/qabul/rad va uzr
topics.example: Thanks for inviting me. I can come.

topics.title: Sodda paragraf: tajriba/reja/tavsif
topics.example: O‘tgan voqea va keyingi rejani yozish.

topics.title: Tinglash: asosiy mazmun va detallar
topics.example: Kim, qachon, sabab va keyingi harakatni topish.

topics.title: Gapirish: ketma-ket savol-javob va qayta ifodalash
A2 yakuniy amaliy tekshiruv va portfolio
topics.example: Sayohat + xarid + hikoya + reja: yangi sharoitda.
